description: This file defines the NoteService class that provides methods to interact with notes via HTTP requests or mock API functions, including CRUD operations.

classes.name: NoteService
classes.description: Service class for managing notes, with methods to fetch, create, update, and delete notes.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Fetches all notes, either from real API or mock, based on environment configuration.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Fetches a single note by ID, either from real API or mock.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new note with given title and content, using real API or mock.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing note identified by ID with new title and content.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Deletes a note by ID, returning true upon success.
